title: Senior System & Network Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior System & Network Engineer to manage, maintain, secure, and optimise our organisation's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in network administration, Windows and Linux servers, firewalls, VPNs, Active Directory, and IT security. The candidate should also be familiar with AI-powered tools and automation to improve infrastructure monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, and day-to-day IT operations. Key Responsibilities Manage, monitor, and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, network switches, routers, and other network infrastructure. Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLANs, routing, ACLs, DHCP, and DNS. Administer and maintain Windows Server, Linux servers, Active Directory, Group Policy, and user access management. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot firewalls, UTM appliances, VPNs, and network security policies, preferably using Sophos. Monitor network performance, availability, bandwidth utilisation, and security events to ensure smooth IT operations. Manage and troubleshoot Wi-Fi access points, CCTV cameras, VoIP systems, LAN cabling, and desktop connectivity. Perform Windows and Linux OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting. Maintain Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise applications. Monitor security alerts, identify potential threats, and support vulnerability management and incident response. Manage IT assets, backups, system updates, access controls, and infrastructure documentation. Coordinate with internet service providers, hardware vendors, and other service providers to resolve infrastructure issues. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimise recurring incidents and downtime. Support IT infrastructure upgrades, migrations, capacity planning, and disaster recovery activities. Use AI-powered tools and automation to improve IT support, troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational efficiency. Required Technical Skills Networking: Strong knowledge of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, ACLs, and network troubleshooting. Network Security: Hands-on experience with firewalls, UTM, VPN, access control, intrusion detection, and security best practices. Network Devices: Experience configuring and managing Cisco switches, routers, Wi-Fi access points, and other network equipment. Wi-Fi & Wireless Networking: Strong understanding of Wi-Fi concepts, including 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz and 6 GHz bands, Wi-Fi standards (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax), SSID, wireless security (WPA2/WPA3), channel planning, bandwidth, roaming, signal strength, and interference troubleshooting. Ubiquiti UniFi: Hands-on experience with Ubiquiti UniFi access points, UniFi Network Controller, and cloud-based Wi-Fi configuration and management. Cloud-Based Wi-Fi Management: Knowledge of configuring and managing wireless networks through cloud dashboards, including SSID creation, VLAN mapping, guest Wi-Fi, bandwidth limits, captive portals, access control, and firmware upgrades. Wi-Fi Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Ability to monitor connected clients, access point health, signal strength, channel utilisation, wireless performance, and troubleshoot connectivity and coverage issues. Wireless Network Security: Experience implementing secure Wi-Fi access, guest network isolation, client authentication, and integration with enterprise LAN and firewall policies. Windows Administration: Knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and user management. Linux Administration: Basic to intermediate experience with Linux installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting. Firewall & VPN: Experience with Sophos or other enterprise firewall solutions, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs. Desktop Support: Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows desktops, laptops, printers, Outlook, and business applications. IT Infrastructure: Knowledge of CCTV, VoIP, LAN cabling, patch panels, structured cabling, and hardware installation. Monitoring & Security: Experience with network monitoring, log analysis, performance monitoring, and security incident handling. AI & Automation Skills Familiarity with AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools for IT troubleshooting and operational support. Ability to use AI tools to analyse system logs, network errors, alerts, and incident reports. Knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python for routine system administration tasks. Understanding of AI-assisted incident analysis, root cause investigation, and IT documentation. Familiarity with AI-powered IT monitoring, alert correlation, and AIOps concepts is an added advantage. Ability to identify repetitive IT tasks and explore opportunities to automate them using scripts and AI-assisted workflows. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. CCNA/RHCA certification is preferred. Microsoft Windows Server / Azure Administrator or relevant Microsoft certification is an advantage. Sophos or other firewall vendor certification is an added advantage. Experience working in an enterprise IT infrastructure or IT operations environment. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, teamwork, and coordination skills.

title: Deputy General Manager - Smart Campus
description:
Job Description 
 Deputy General Manager (DGM) Smart Campus 
 Department Digital Technology Reports To Chief Digital Officer Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat Employment Type Full-Time 
 Role Summary
The DGM Smart Campus will lead the strategy, design, and execution of Smart Campus IT infrastructure across the organization's campus locations. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of smart campus technologies from strategic planning and vendor selection through deployment, integration, and operations spanning IoT device ecosystems, data center build-outs, network infrastructure, and campus-wide digital systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven program leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
 Define and drive the long-term Smart Campus technology roadmap aligned with organizational goals (sustainability, safety, efficiency, user experience).
 Define & design architectures aligned with organizational goals covering the smart campus roadmap
 Evaluate emerging technologies (IoT, edge computing, AI-enabled building systems, 5G/Wi-Fi 6, smart energy management) and assess fit for campus deployment.
¢ Develop business cases, budgets, and ROI models for smart campus initiatives.
¢ Partner with leadership to align IT infrastructure investment with institutional/organizational growth plans.
IoT & Smart Infrastructure Execution
¢ Lead design, procurement, and deployment of IoT device ecosystems across campus smart lighting, HVAC, access control, occupancy sensors, environmental monitoring, surveillance, energy metering, parking, and asset tracking.
¢ Oversee IoT platform architecture including device management, connectivity (LoRaWAN, Zigbee, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular), edge gateways, and cloud/on-prem integration.
¢ Ensure interoperability across multi-vendor IoT systems and integration with central building management systems (BMS/BAS) and campus management platforms.
¢ Establish standards for IoT security, device provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and data governance.
Data Center Build & Infrastructure
¢ Lead planning, design, and execution of data center build-outs (greenfield and expansion) including site selection, power and cooling design, redundancy (N+1/2N), and physical security.
¢ Manage data center infrastructure lifecycle: server/storage/network hardware, virtualization, structured cabling, UPS, generators, and environmental monitoring systems.
¢ Ensure compliance with relevant standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier standards, ISO 27001) and local regulatory requirements.
¢ Drive capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategy for campus data infrastructure.
Program & Vendor Management
¢ Manage full project lifecycle: scoping, RFPs, vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, implementation, and handover to operations.
¢ Own budgets, timelines, and delivery quality across concurrent smart campus and infrastructure projects.
¢ Build and manage relationships with OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers, and consultants.
¢ Establish SLAs and governance frameworks for ongoing operations and maintenance.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
¢ Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning network engineering, IoT/embedded systems, data center operations, and project management.
¢ Act as the key liaison between IT, facilities, security, academic/business units, and executive leadership.
¢ Present roadmaps, project status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and governance committees.
¢ Drive change management and user adoption for new smart campus systems.
Governance, Security & Compliance
¢ Ensure infrastructure design adheres to cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation for OT/IoT environments.
¢ Own risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for infrastructure projects.
¢ Establish monitoring, incident response, and maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
Required Qualifications
¢ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Master's/MBA preferred).
¢ 1218+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing smart campus, smart building, or large-scale IoT deployments.
¢ Demonstrated experience leading data center build projects from design through commissioning.
¢ Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or equivalent).
¢ Experience with structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, wireless infrastructure, and data center facilities (power, cooling, redundancy).
¢ Proven track record managing multi-crore/multi-million-dollar infrastructure budgets and large vendor ecosystems.
¢ Familiarity with BMS/BAS integration, physical security systems, and energy management platforms.
¢ Strong project management skills (PMP/PRINCE2 certification preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS (Data Center), CCNP/CCIE, or IoT-specific certifications.
¢ Experience in campus environments (corporate, educational institution, or industrial park).
¢ Exposure to sustainability/green building initiatives (LEED, IGBC) and smart energy systems.
¢ Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for OT/IoT (NIST, ISO 27001).
Key Competencies
¢ Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability
¢ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
¢ Vendor negotiation and contract management
¢ Cross-functional team leadership
¢ Problem-solving under complex, multi-vendor technical environments
¢ Budget ownership and financial acumen
